scripts.icon:build: mkdir -p build/icon.iconset && swiftc native/IconGenerator.swift -framework CoreGraphics -framework ImageIO -o /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator && /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator ../md.icon/Assets/MDaily.png build/icon.iconset/icon_16x16.png 16 && /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator ../md.icon/Assets/MDaily.png build/icon.iconset/icon_16x16@2x.png 32 && /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator ../md.icon/Assets/MDaily.png build/icon.iconset/icon_32x32.png 32 && /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator ../md.icon/Assets/MDaily.png build/icon.iconset/icon_32x32@2x.png 64 && /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator ../md.icon/Assets/MDaily.png build/icon.iconset/icon_128x128.png 128 && /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator ../md.icon/Assets/MDaily.png build/icon.iconset/icon_128x128@2x.png 256 && /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator ../md.icon/Assets/MDaily.png build/icon.iconset/icon_256x256.png 256 && /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator ../md.icon/Assets/MDaily.png build/icon.iconset/icon_256x256@2x.png 512 && /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator ../md.icon/Assets/MDaily.png build/icon.iconset/icon_512x512.png 512 && /tmp/mdaily-icon-generator ../md.icon/Assets/MDaily.png build/icon.iconset/icon_512x512@2x.png 1024 && iconutil -c icns build/icon.iconset -o build/icon.icns
scripts.native:build: mkdir -p build/native && swiftc -parse-as-library -O -framework Vision -framework ImageIO native/ReceiptAnalyzer.swift -o build/native/receipt-analyzer
scripts.build: npm run icon:build && npm run native:build && tsc && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:mac:intel: npm run icon:build && npm run native:build && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --config.mac.target=dir
